create.name: Ashtanga Yoga Centre of Toronto
create.bio:
The Ashtanga Yoga Centre of Toronto, known as AYCT, has taught Ashtanga in the Mysore tradition since 2008, when it opened as a welcoming base for the city's Ashtanga community. Its Mysore programme, which the centre counts among the largest in the world, is led by David Robson and Jelena Vesić, both Level 2 authorised teachers. They are known for supporting long-term and advanced students, and they are just as keen to introduce the method to people trying it for the first time, for whom they also publish online resources.

The practice links the breath to a sequence of postures that grows steadily more demanding, and the centre puts its trust in consistent practice and steady teaching, holding that rigour can sit alongside a careful, safe approach. Mysore practice starts early on weekday mornings and a led primary class runs on Saturdays, with no Mysore class on new and full moon days, which the centre lists in advance. Newcomers can begin with an introductory workshop for up to 15 people that teaches the fundamentals slowly, or with a low-cost first week of unlimited classes. The studio is on Yonge Street, a few blocks north of Lawrence subway station.

courses.title: Monthly memberships and class passes
courses.description: Monthly memberships (limited or unlimited access) and class passes for the centre's Mysore and led classes, plus a one-week introductory offer for first-time students in the Toronto area; student and senior rates are sold in the studio.
courses.price: Introductory Special $49; Limited Access $210 per month; Unlimited Access $235 per month; Student & Senior Access $175 per month; Single Pass $35; 1 Month Unlimited $260; 10 Class Card $280; 20 Class Card $485

courses.title: Intro Workshop
courses.description: An introduction to the fundamentals of Ashtanga, taught slowly and thoroughly to a group of no more than 15 students. Dates are given on the centre's schedule.
